title.en: Periodic molecular images without fabricated motion

summary: Validate wrapping and whole-molecule reconstruction as coordinate transformations distinct from temporal unwrapping or alignment.
objective: Inspect a molecule crossing a periodic cell and distinguish wrapped atoms, an intact molecular image and any separately supplied continuous trajectory.
intent_signals: Inspect a molecule crossing a periodic cell and distinguish wrapped atoms, an intact molecular image and any separately supplied continuous trajectory.
example_prompts: Inspect a molecule crossing a periodic cell and distinguish wrapped atoms, an intact molecular image and any separately supplied continuous trajectory.
applies_when: Validate wrapping and whole-molecule reconstruction as coordinate transformations distinct from temporal unwrapping or alignment.

principles: Name the transformation being displayed: wrapping a frame, making a molecule whole, rigid-body alignment, and reconstructing continuous travel answer different questions.
Preserve original coordinates and cell metadata. A molecule that appears broken at a cell boundary should not be repaired by inventing new bonds or by deleting a fragment.
implementation: Use the current frame cell with the declared box-vector convention, including nonorthogonal cells when supported. If the cell is missing or degenerate, report periodic transformation unavailable rather than assuming a unit cube.

For MDAnalysis wrap choose the compound scope; keeping a compound together does not require every atom to lie inside the primary cell. For whole-molecule unwrap require appropriate connectivity and keep its in-place coordinate mutation out of preserved source frames.

Store transformation order, reference selections and cell revision with derived coordinates. Treat per-frame whole-molecule reconstruction as insufficient authority for a diffusion path; only offer temporal unwrapping when a separately documented continuity method and assumptions are supplied.

Seek from the unmodified requested frame and its cell, or from a reproducible declared transform cache. Disable interpolation across a periodic jump unless interpolation is explicitly performed in an appropriate reconstructed representation.
observable_checks: For a synthetic bonded pair at x=9.8 and x=0.2 in a 10-unit periodic axis, whole-image reconstruction presents a 0.4-unit separation without changing atom or bond identity.
Wrap by compound and permit peripheral atoms outside the box when the compound center is inside; do not flag that documented behavior as failed atom-wise wrapping.
Seek frame 8, frame 2, then frame 8: derived coordinates match the declared transform result, source coordinates remain intact, and a missing-cell frame reports unavailable.

known_limits: No diffusion estimator, minimum-image algorithm or temporal unwrapping implementation is supplied. Connectivity-based reconstruction is unsuitable for unsupported reactive/bond-changing systems.
Authored source-reviewed guidance only; no import adapter, runtime artifact or scientific pipeline was implemented or executed.
creative_affordances: Use a compact source-versus-display inspector to expose the specific transformation; layout and emphasis are authored choices, not validated usability findings.

claims.statement: MDAnalysis wrap shifts atoms or chosen compounds into a cell; compound wrapping may leave some atoms outside. Its unwrap transformation moves atoms to avoid split molecular bonds and modifies positions in place.
claims.scope: MDAnalysis 2.10.0 per-frame image transformations; does not establish temporal continuity.

source_refs.locator: wrap Notes and compound parameter; unwrap description and in-place modification
